# get_waypoint

## Purpose

Read one waypoint from its ID: its altitude and GPS coordinates, and for a hut, gîte or bivouac its capacity, custodianship and access period. It also gives the summary, description and access text, the areas it belongs to, its routes, the books that cover it and its recent outings. Use it for any summit altitude or hut detail. A virtual waypoint is a grouping with no real location, so it has no altitude or coordinates.

- `lang`: Language of titles and texts, one of: fr, en, de, it, es, ca, eu, sl, zh (default fr). Values: `fr`, `en`, `de`, `it`, `es`, `ca`, `eu`, `sl`, `zh`
